call_points.text: Added 4,892 macro towers and 6,192 co-locations during Q4 FY26.
Energy margins were at negative 3.6% in Q4 FY26 compared to negative 5.2% last year.
Board recommended final dividend of ₹14 per share, reflecting strong free cash flow generation.
70% of capex is growth-oriented, driven by strong order book in India.
Africa expansion progressing with operating license secured in Zambia.

entities.name: Indus Towers Global Ventures IFSC Limited

operating_notes.text: Indus Towers Global Ventures IFSC Limited, incorporated in GIFT City on April 28, 2026, is to act as investment holding company for the company's overseas subsidiaries and undertake treasury functions; it is yet to commence business operati
Africa expansion is progressing with operating license secured in Zambia.
CFO and KMP Vikas Poddar resigned on May 21, 2026, effective close of business August 18, 2026, to pursue opportunities outside the company; no successor named.
Added about 3,100 macro towers and 4,200 colocations in Q1FY27; total macro towers ~267,600 and colocations ~432,300.
Diesel consumption fell 13% YoY; solar access added to ~3,700 sites, taking total to ~46,000 sites; installed solar base 259 MW.
Order book described as firm for the next 3-4 quarters, combining network expansion and movement of expired tenancies.

timeline.summary: Indus Towers scheduled its Q4 FY26 financial results announcement for April 30, 2026, and its earnings call for May 1, 2026.

On April 29, 2026, Indus Towers said its wholly owned subsidiary Indus Towers Global Ventures IFSC Limited was incorporated in GIFT City on April 28, 2026 with ₹2 Cr of capital, to hold overseas subsidiaries and run treasury functions.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,101 Cr (+4.8% YoY), net profit ₹1,792.9 Cr (+0.8% YoY).
Indus Towers Limited’s Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹14 per share (face value ₹10) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Indus Towers reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹325,000 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹14 per share.
On May 22, 2026, Indus Towers disclosed that CFO and KMP Vikas Poddar resigned on May 21, 2026, effective close of business on August 18, 2026, to pursue opportunities outside the company.
Bharti Airtel Limited, via **Rohit Kapoor**, declared no encumbrance on Indus Towers shares held during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q1FY27 earnings call: revenue ₹8,430 Cr (+4.6% YoY), PAT ₹1,750 Cr (+0.5% YoY); Africa rollouts to start next quarter.
Indus Towers scheduled its Q2FY27 results for October 27, 2026, and an earnings conference call for October 28, 2026.
